title: The removed defaulting.webhook.karpenter.sh is still registered
quote: The `defaulting.webhook.karpenter.sh` mutating webhook was removed in `0.27.3`. If you are coming from an older version of Karpenter where this webhook existed and the webhook was not managed by Helm, you may need to delete the stale webhook.
remediation: Remove the stale MutatingWebhookConfiguration named defaulting.webhook.karpenter.sh. Karpenter 0.27.3 dropped the webhook but Helm does not clean up a configuration it never owned, so it keeps intercepting API calls with no backend to serve them.
verifyCommand: kubectl get mutatingwebhookconfigurations -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name == "defaulting.webhook.karpenter.sh") | "\(.metadata.name) service=\(.webhooks[0].clientConfig.service.namespace // "?")/\(.webhooks[0].clientConfig.service.name // "?")"'  # a row printed is the stale webhook; its backing service no longer exists after 0.27.3

title: Karpenter replicas now require one node each

detection.reason: settling this needs the controller's replica count compared against the number of schedulable nodes at upgrade time, and pod-level anti-affinity is not part of the collected workload projection

quote: The Karpenter controller pods now deploy with `kubernetes.io/hostname` self anti-affinity by default. If you are running Karpenter in HA (high-availability) mode and you do not have enough nodes to match the number of pod replicas you are deploying with, you will need to scale-out your nodes for Karpenter.
remediation: Check that the cluster has at least as many schedulable nodes as the Karpenter deployment has replicas. With `kubernetes.io/hostname` self anti-affinity the surplus replicas stay Pending after the upgrade — which on a cluster that depends on Karpenter for capacity is a deadlock.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.template.spec.containers[]?.image? // "" | test("karpenter/controller")) | "replicas=\(.spec.replicas) \(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"'; kubectl get nodes --no-headers | wc -l  # replicas must not exceed the node count, or the extra Karpenter pods stay Pending
